title: Staged payload executed from a document
description: Positive, in the device path form: a WINWORD.EXE parent spawns an executable from the user's AppData\Local\Temp folder, both paths written behind \Device\HarddiskVolume3. rule.staged_payload_execution matches and exactly one alert is emitted with final_score 0.8; no other rule fires on either event. Run in CI by rules_ac_003 against the whole rule set.
